description: `between` requires numbers together or words together; a boolean value raises `ol-type` naming the concept "number or word" (spec/execution-model.md:146-166, error-model.md `ol-type`) — the `operation` param reads "between" (not an ordering-operator symbol) so the diagnostic names the form the learner actually wrote. Measured, this implementation's checker reports nothing for this program, so Phase 2 begins and execution halts at the failing statement, keeping the `instruction` event asserted below. The operands are literals, so the fault is statically knowable: `spec/tooling.md:197-200` says a semantic tool SHOULD report statically knowable uses of runtime C10 codes, so a checker that folded this call would report it at `semantic` and would also conform. The stage below records what this implementation does, not an inherent property of the fault. Issue #99; see issue #1156 for the superseded rationale.
